requirement.evidence: adopted the Annual General Adjustment (AGA) Order for Year 2026 which will allow eligible landlords to increase the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than January 1, 2026.
requirement.note: Regulation 1148 conditions and notice, and the phone number, are also in the document. 'No more than 1.0%' is a mild paraphrase of the increase allowed.

key_value.evidence: The 2026 AGA of 1.0% represents 65% of the increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) for All Urban Consumers in the Bay Area during the period from July 1, 2024 - June 30, 2025, which was 1.5% as posted by the Bureau of Labor Statistics.

effective_date.evidence: increase the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than January 1, 2026.
effective_date.note: January 1, 2026 is the earliest date the increase may take effect.

status.evidence: At its regular meeting on October 16, 2025, the Berkeley Rent Stabilization Board adopted the Annual General Adjustment (AGA) Order for Year 2026
status.note: The order was adopted and applies from 2026-01-01, so in_force as of 2026-10-01 is a reasonable inference. The document does not state current status explicitly and was posted in October 2025.

coverage.note: Coverage is null on the card.

citation.evidence: See Berkeley Municipal Code section 13.76.110A. for rules related to establishing the AGA.
citation.note: BMC 13.76.110A and Regulation 1148 are both named in the document. However, the card cites § 13.76.110A with Regulation 1148 in parentheses, which blurs them. 110A covers how the AGA is established, while Regulation 1148 is the Order itself.
